note: Which Fusion document build.py builds into.
Fusion documents live in Autodesk's cloud: there is no local live .f3d, and
Save As to disk is not available. So the document is scratch state, not an
asset. This file names it; the tracked text (parameters.json, build.py,
reference/board.json) remains the source of truth, and the document can be
deleted and rebuilt at any time.
build.py refuses to run unless the *active* document's name matches `name`,
so a rebuild cannot accidentally land in the wrong document. Set project
only to document which hub project it lives in; it is informational.
Because the document is shared globally, two worktrees must not build into
it at the same time -- the script clears its own features before redrawing.
name: card-holder
